'''Crolar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] of unidentified species, reaching a height of three feet. This person was seen in [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]], the City of Masks, in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. Like all the visitors and many inhabitants, this person was in disguise, particularly with a tray on his head. This allowed him to watch the girls' legs without their consents. Sometimes, an unaware dancer laid a cup on Crolar's tray, and then Crolar moved away and drank it for free.
